nodes.description: Constant contract-level token name string 'Tekno Token'.
Constant contract-level token symbol 'TEKNO'.
Constant token decimals value set to 16 (non-standard for ERC20).
Mapping(address => uint256) storing the token balance of every holder.
Nested mapping owner => spender => uint256 allowance.
Total token supply, written once in the constructor and never minted again.
Sets totalSupply_ to the constructor argument and credits the whole supply to balances[msg.sender].
View function returning totalSupply_.
View function returning balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers numTokens from balances[msg.sender] to balances[receiver] after a require check.
Overwrites allowed[msg.sender][delegate] with numTokens without any restriction or reset-to-zero pattern.
View function returning allowed[owner][delegate].
Moves numTokens from owner to buyer, requiring sufficient owner balance and sufficient allowance of msg.sender.
Library subtraction that asserts b <= a before computing a - b.
Library addition that stores a + b in a local and asserts c >= a to detect overflow.
Caller-controlled address used as balance/allowance owner in constructor, transfer, approve and transferFrom.
Debit of the caller balance guarded only by require(numTokens <= balances[msg.sender]); the allowance path is absent.
Credit of the receiver balance using SafeMath.add which relies on assert for overflow protection.
Unconditional allowance overwrite enabling the classic ERC20 approve/transferFrom front-running race.
Decrement of the caller allowance after require(numTokens <= allowed[owner][msg.sender]).
Debit of the owner balance after require(numTokens <= balances[owner]).
Credit of the buyer balance inside transferFrom.
assert(b <= a) reverts on underflow, then returns a - b.
Unchecked addition whose overflow is only detected through assert(c >= a).
Initial total supply passed to the constructor.
Address whose balance is queried.
Recipient address of the transfer.
Amount of tokens to move in transfer.
Spender address granted an allowance.
Allowance amount written for the delegate.
Owner address queried for its allowance.
Spender address queried for its allowance.
Address whose balance and allowance are debited.
Address credited in transferFrom.
Amount moved in transferFrom.
Local variable holding the result of a + b in SafeMath.add.

edges.reason: transfer consumes the receiver address parameter.
transfer consumes the numTokens amount parameter.
approve consumes the delegate parameter.
approve consumes the numTokens amount parameter.
allowance consumes the owner parameter.
allowance consumes the delegate parameter.
transferFrom consumes the owner parameter.
transferFrom consumes the buyer parameter.
transferFrom consumes the numTokens amount parameter.
balanceOf consumes the tokenOwner parameter.
constructor consumes the total supply parameter.
numTokens flows into the caller balance subtraction in transfer.
numTokens flows into the receiver balance addition in transfer.
numTokens is written into the allowance mapping in approve.
numTokens is subtracted from the caller allowance in transferFrom.
numTokens is subtracted from the owner balance in transferFrom.
numTokens is added to the buyer balance in transferFrom.
buyer address is the key credited in the transferFrom balance update.
owner address is the key debited in the transferFrom balance update.
owner address is the outer key of the allowance mapping mutated by transferFrom.
msg.sender determines which balance is debited in transfer.
msg.sender writes an allowance for itself; the caller fully controls the approval entry.
msg.sender acts as the spender key whose allowance is checked and decremented in transferFrom.
transfer executes the balance subtraction for the caller.
transfer executes the balance addition for the receiver.
approve unconditionally grants the allowance to an arbitrary delegate.
transferFrom decrements the caller allowance after the allowance require check.
transferFrom debits the owner balance.
transferFrom credits the buyer balance.
SafeMath.sub performs the asserted underflow-checked subtraction.
SafeMath.add performs the asserted overflow-checked addition.
constructor assigns the initial value of totalSupply_.
constructor credits the full supply to balances[msg.sender].
totalSupply reads the totalSupply_ state variable.
balanceOf reads from the balances mapping.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
approve writes into the allowed mapping.
allowance reads from the allowed mapping.
transferFrom updates the balances mapping for owner and buyer.
transferFrom updates the allowed mapping for the spender.
local variable c stores the result of a + b before the overflow assert.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter only feeds the initial supply assignment performed by the constructor.
Lookup key parameter used solely by balanceOf.
Destination address parameter consumed only by transfer.
Amount parameter that feeds the transfer balance subtraction and addition.
Spender parameter written into the allowance mapping by approve.
Allowance value parameter written by approve.
Owner query parameter used only by allowance.
Spender query parameter used only by allowance.
Owner parameter that selects the debited balance and allowance entry.
Amount parameter used by the balance and allowance arithmetic in transferFrom.
Local accumulator whose value is asserted and returned by SafeMath.add.
